art.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create an original premium dark-fantasy mobile RPG app icon for Cinder Dominion: Idle RPG. Square 1024x1024 composition, full-bleed opaque background, no rounded corners or outer frame. Central striking sculpted blackened steel crown of five sharp uneven points, split by a narrow glowing ember fissure, an elegant broad sword blade rising behind its center. The silhouette must read instantly at 48 pixels. Close, heroic object-only composition occupying 70 percent of image, front view. Rich forged metal, restrained antique gold edges, vivid molten amber core, cold teal-black atmosphere, deep but visible blue charcoal backdrop with faint smoke, beautiful cinematic rim lighting. Luxurious artisanal AAA fantasy art direction, clear large shapes, minimal micro-detail, powerful and clean. Absolutely no people, faces, skulls, eyes, animals, letters, typography, badges, user interface, app tile frame, watermarks, or logos of other games. Do not make a small emblem on empty space. The crown itself is the bold dominant subject, distinct asymmetrical damaged metal and contained fire, no busy explosion.

art.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: landscape dark-fantasy mobile RPG key art for Cinder Dominion: Idle RPG, banner and cinematic trailer background. Create a breathtaking original wide panoramic 2048x1152 artwork: a colossal black iron citadel rises over a ruined causeway under a storm-dark indigo sky, towers lit by molten amber furnace glow, stone bridges and ash drifting through cold blue mist. The right third shows a single small imposing armored knight seen from behind standing at the entrance, fully enclosed blackened steel armor and heavy dark cloak, no visible skin or face or facial features; below the figure are ancient steps and an ember-lit broad sword. The left half has elegant low-detail shadowed mist and broken distant architecture suitable for large readable typography. Dramatic but controlled warm amber and cold teal contrast, refined painterly realism, richly crafted premium RPG marketing art, impressive scale, clear cinematic depth, restrained sparks, sharp focal architecture with atmosphere. Full bleed rectangular artwork, no border, no mockup, no graphic boxes. Absolutely no text, logos, icons, skull faces, eyes, nose, mouth, uncovered human faces, open visors, exposed skin, crowds, UI, advertising badges or watermarks. Character's head must be completely covered by hood or enclosed helmet and viewed from behind. Do not create a close-up portrait. This is promotional key art for the existing dark fantasy grinding and crafting game, mood dignified and powerful rather than garish.
